games.title: MOTHERLOAD
games.tag: mining roguelite · dig deep, strike it rich
games.blurb: Drill into a procedural planet, haul ore up to sell, upgrade your pod, and chase the Heart of Natas through biomes, shops, a skill tree, missions and daily seeds.

games.title: ECOTONE
games.blurb: A Gen-3-style monster RPG built on a living world: populations grow, crash and migrate as you hunt; seasons and weather repaint the region; every creature evolves into a bespoke form shaped by how you raised it.

games.title: CINDER
games.blurb: A fire spreads across the grid. Wall it into sealed pockets to suffocate it. Bigger captures pay more — but the longer you wait, the faster it spreads.

games.title: SHIFT
games.blurb: Mineral layers push up from below. Slide rows to line up big groups — but matches only resolve on the rise. Time the Shift for a cascade.

games.title: CONDUIT
games.blurb: A source fires a pulse every beat toward a lit sink. Rotate nodes to connect a live path before the beat lands. The beat is the metronome of tension.

games.title: HOMEOSTAT
games.blurb: Reactors drain on their own clocks. One feed stream, one at a time. Keep every needle in its green flow band — a starve or overload ends the run.

games.title: NOVA
games.blurb: Drop glowing motes into a gravity basin. Equal masses fuse upward — bigger, brighter, worth more — chaining toward a supernova. Don't let the stack crest the rim.

games.title: SURGE
games.blurb: Charged orbs drift and pile up. Spend a charge to fire an arc that rips through the cluster — every orb detonates its neighbours. Wait for density; don't overload.

games.title: CLEAVE
games.blurb: A crystal grows from a colored stream. Swipe to cleave straight through it — any pure-color vein your cut crosses shatters. Grow a region big before you slice; the chamber is filling.

games.title: FLUX
games.blurb: Charged particles pour down the field. Hold to drop a magnetic pole that bends them toward their matching collector. Bank a color streak — or let the spill overflow.

games.title: WEAVE
games.blurb: Charged nodes rain into a pile. Trace one stroke through touching nodes of the same charge to wire a circuit, then let go — a current rips down the wire you drew. Longer snakes pay far more.

games.title: PULSE
games.blurb: Motes spiral into a reactor core. Tap on the beat to fire a shockwave that scours them — nail the rhythm to ride a groove. The tempo only ever climbs.

games.title: INTERCEPT
games.blurb: Threats rain down toward your sites. Finite interceptors, more targets than you can save — tap to detonate a blast and choose what lives. Catch several at once for an escalating multi-kill bonus as the barrage climbs.

games.title: DESCENT
games.blurb: You're falling down a shaft — steer left and right to thread the gaps. Slip past wall blocks, thread a gate's slot, weave around mid-shaft pillars. Charges pump a multiplier that scales every metre, but reaching them pulls you off your line. One hit ends the dive.
